title: Agreement for Special Inspection Services for Construction – North American Technical Services, Inc. – Roosevelt Middle School Modernization Project – Division of Facilities Planning and Management
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of an Agreement for Special Inspection Services for Construction by and between the District and North American Technical Services, Inc., Modesto, CA, for the latter to provide special inspection services during off-site shop fabrication, for modular building and restroom portable, in compliance to the Division of the State Architect (DSA) requirements, and provide a Visual Inspection Report of In-Plant Inspection of on-site stockpiled buildings for general condition, limited tests for door and window operation and note any significant deficiencies, for the Roosevelt Middle School Modernization Project, in a not-to-exceed amount of $14,900.00, which includes a not-to-exceed amount of $4,000.00 for Additional Services, with the work scheduled to commence on September 28, 2023, and scheduled to last until December 31, 2024.
presenter: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
headline: Pays North American Technical Services up to $14,900 to inspect modular buildings for Roosevelt Middle School
summary: The district would hire North American Technical Services, Inc. to inspect modular buildings and a restroom portable during factory fabrication, and to report on the condition of buildings stored on site. The inspections follow Division of the State Architect (DSA) requirements for the Roosevelt Middle School Modernization Project. The limit includes up to $4,000 for additional services, and work would run from September 28, 2023 to December 31, 2024.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report
